clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, Dalar Dawnweaver seeks Arugal's spell to learn how his worgen magic works.

Before taking Shadowfang Keep, Archmage Arugal sheltered at an abandoned wheat farm north of the river bridge in Silverpine Forest. He recorded his strange arts in spellbooks left among the farm tools and rotting floorboards. One scroll, the Remedy of Arugal, describes early methods and magical formulas from his experiments with the transmutations that cursed the local people.

Dalar Dawnweaver, a Forsaken spellcaster at the Sepulcher, thinks little of Arugal's standing and considers his intellect fragile and transparent. Still, Dawnweaver needs to understand the worgen curse's workings. Recovering the Remedy gives Forsaken agents the arcane knowledge Dawnweaver seeks to counter Arugal's spreading menace and secure Silverpine for Lady Sylvanas.
